rust_summary: an item fallback after a native mob's ordinary interaction passed.
doc_summary: `native_item_interact_mob(entity, kind, stack, swing)` runs after ordinary entity interactions pass, for an alive native Mob selected by the exact packet ID or unobstructed crosshair. First `Some(true)` owns and swings once; `Some(false)` owns without a swing; `None` passes. The nonempty stack belongs to the acting hand. Armor stands, other real players and dragon-part tables are not covered. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_interact_mob@.
